name: Age Estimate
description: Look up a population-level age estimate and the number of observations behind it. Estimates are not certain or individual predictions.
template: <Stack gap="xs"><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Text fw={600} truncate>Age estimate</Text><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Agify · population data</Text></Group><TextInput bind="name" label="Full name" placeholder="e.g. Michael" /><TextInput bind="country" label="Country code (optional)" placeholder="US" maxLength={2} /><Text size="xs" c="dimmed">An estimate from observed data, not a certainty about any individual.</Text>{(inputs.name ?? "").trim().length === 0 ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">Enter a full name to get started.</Text> : (inputs.country ?? "").trim().length === 0 ? <SubFetch requestId="predict" trigger="manual" params={{ name: inputs.name.trim() }} triggerContent={<Text>Estimate age</Text>} triggerAriaLabel="Estimate age">{(result) => <Stack gap="xs"><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate>{result.name ?? inputs.name}</Text><RefreshButton requestId="predict" /></Group>{result.age === null || result.age === undefined ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No estimate yet · {result.count?.toLocaleString("en-US") ?? 0} observations</Text> : <Group align="baseline" gap="xs"><Text fz={30} fw={700} c="blue">{result.age}</Text><Text size="sm">estimated years</Text></Group>}<Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Based on {result.count?.toLocaleString("en-US") ?? 0} observations{result.country_id ? ` · ${result.country_id}` : ""}; not a certainty.</Text></Stack>}</SubFetch> : <SubFetch requestId="predictByCountry" trigger="manual" params={{ name: inputs.name.trim(), country: inputs.country.trim().toUpperCase() }} triggerContent={<Text>Estimate age</Text>} triggerAriaLabel="Estimate age">{(result) => <Stack gap="xs"><Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate>{result.name ?? inputs.name}</Text><RefreshButton requestId="predictByCountry" /></Group>{result.age === null || result.age === undefined ? <Text size="sm" c="dimmed">No estimate yet · {result.count?.toLocaleString("en-US") ?? 0} observations</Text> : <Group align="baseline" gap="xs"><Text fz={30} fw={700} c="blue">{result.age}</Text><Text size="sm">estimated years</Text></Group>}<Text size="xs" c="dimmed">Based on {result.count?.toLocaleString("en-US") ?? 0} observations{result.country_id ? ` · ${result.country_id}` : ""}; not a certainty.</Text></Stack>}</SubFetch>}</Stack>
